question: A nursery raised 64 trays of tomato seedlings with 7 seedlings in each tray, in a greenhouse 20 metres long. Half of the seedlings were planted in the east field. Each seedling in the east field produced 6 tomatoes. The gardener added 50 tomatoes from a small side plot to the east field's harvest, and then threw away 51 tomatoes that had rotted. How many tomatoes were left from the east field's harvest?

Kit had 61 cents in her money box. She added 71 cents that she found in the car and then 50 cents from her grandfather. Her brother paid back 49 cents he had borrowed. She then spent 224 cents on a comic book. Kit prefers to write her savings in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in her money box now?

In the morning, 8 vans left the parcel depot, which is 15 kilometres from the town centre, with 232 parcels in each van, and half of the drivers were new. By midday 860 parcels had been delivered. In the afternoon the vans collected 45 parcels from a shop and 47 from an office. In the evening they collected 70 parcels from a warehouse. How many parcels are in the vans now?

Ana's garden pond held 24 goldfish, fewer than the 30 in Ben's pond. She bought 26 more fish for it. A heron then took 32 fish. Over the summer the fish bred until there were 8 times as many fish in the pond. In autumn Ana added 56 fish that Ben no longer wanted. She measures the pond's water in litres, though the pump is rated in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many goldfish are in Ana's pond now?

Priya keeps her violin practice log in minutes, though she knows that sixty minutes make an hour and may convert it later. This week she practiced for 84 minutes on each of 3 mornings. In the afternoon her teacher reviewed the log, split that total into 2 equal parts, and said that only one of those parts counted as focused practice. That evening Priya compared notes with her cousin Dev, whose focused practice comes to 6 times her focused total, so Dev's amount is much larger than hers. If Dev keeps up that same amount for 3 weeks, how many minutes of focused practice will Dev log in total?

On Saturday the Alvarez parents put 108 minutes of tablet time into a jar to be shared equally among their 4 children. Lena used 13 minutes of her share on a puzzle game and another 3 minutes checking the weather. Her brother Tomas had not touched his own share yet, so at that point Tomas had more time left than Lena. Lena then earned 51 extra minutes by washing the car, and in the evening her parents made whatever she had 2 times as large for a good report card. The family rule book, which runs to 9 pages, states limits in hours rather than minutes, so Lena had to remember that sixty minutes make an hour. How many minutes of tablet time does Lena have now?

Nadia keeps track of the photos on her phone in megabytes, though she knows that a thousand megabytes make a gigabyte and her plan is billed in gigabytes. Her phone started the year with no photos on it. Every day of an 8-day holiday she added 21 megabytes of photos, and over the year she went on 4 holidays of exactly that pattern. Afterward she deleted 417 megabytes of blurry shots. Her sister then sent her 11 megabytes of group pictures, which she saved. How many megabytes of photos does Nadia have now?

Dario belongs to a coffee shop rewards program and has been a member for half a year. He earned 170 points in each of the last 7 weeks. The shop, which has 3 locations in town, gave him a 48-point birthday bonus. A survey he filled out added another 13 points. He then redeemed 1200 points for a coffee grinder. How many points does Dario have left in his account?

Rosa earned 205 dollars in each of the 4 weeks of June. Her roommate Kei earned the same 205 dollars a week but keeps all of it in one envelope, so Kei's envelope holds more than any of Rosa's. Rosa split her June earnings equally among 4 envelopes labelled rent, groceries, savings and fun. She then divided the fun envelope equally across the 5 weekends in July. Rosa's cousin also mailed her a 20-dollar gift card, which she is saving for December. For the first July weekend Kei chipped in 5 dollars so they could share a pizza. How many dollars does Rosa have to spend on that first weekend?

The Hollis brickyard, open for a dozen years, was completely empty at the start of the week. A pallet holds 192 bricks, each delivery truck carries 9 pallets, and 5 trucks arrive every day. Over 4 days the yard received deliveries at that rate and stacked every brick in its stock. Ada, the yard manager, then found 35 loose bricks behind the office and added them to the stock. A builder named Ben bought 16486 bricks for a housing project, an amount vastly larger than Ada's little pile. How many bricks remain in the yard's stock?

Ida runs the loading dock at a hardware warehouse and was packing a single order of screws. In the morning she packed 114 screws into each small box and 9 boxes into each carton, then had every carton split into 2 equal halves so the halves would fit on the conveyor. In the afternoon 4 half-cartons went into each crate and 6 crates were stacked on each pallet. In the evening 5 full pallets were loaded onto the truck for the customer, Ravi. Ravi later sent back 43062 screws that were the wrong thread size, so Ida's shipment was far larger than Ravi's return. How many screws did Ravi keep?

Each morning Tara's first oven tray comes out with 102 bread rolls, but today 22 of them were burnt and thrown away, and then 66 rolls from the next batch were added to the tray. She filled 4 trays to that same count and divided all of those rolls equally among 4 delivery baskets. Her rival Bruno still packs only 102 rolls per basket, so each of Tara's baskets holds more than one of Bruno's. Tara delivers one such basket to the Grand Hotel on each of 5 days, and the hotel chef records bread by the dozen rather than by the roll and converts the count later. For a banquet the hotel also ordered 24 extra rolls. How many rolls did the Grand Hotel receive from Tara in total?

On Monday morning Farmer Hale collected 147 eggs and sold 90 of them at the farm gate. In the afternoon her nephew Theo collected 65 more, though Theo's haul was smaller than Hale's morning collection. In the evening she divided all the eggs on hand into 2 equal crates, keeping one crate for the Saturday stall. Hale sends 6 crates of that same size to the stall every week and keeps that up for 9 weeks. The stall ledger counts eggs in dozens rather than singles, so the clerk converts the numbers at the end. How many eggs in total does Hale send to the stall over those 9 weeks?

The Chen family set aside 114 dollars for a picnic. They spent 86 dollars on food and 16 dollars on drinks, and the leftover was split equally among the 6 children as pocket money. Mei, the youngest, decided to save her share, and her parents made that same amount her weekly pocket money, so she saved every payment for 9 weeks. Her grandmother, who still thinks in cents and reminded her that a hundred cents make a dollar, then added 40 dollars to Mei's savings. How many dollars does Mei have saved?

Dana runs a lemonade stall at a market whose till counts in cents, so she converts every hundred cents into a dollar when she writes up her book in dollars. In the morning the stall took 88 dollars, and 58 dollars more came in before noon. In the afternoon it took 67 dollars, and in the evening another 42 dollars. She took exactly that same daily amount on each of the 6 days the market ran. All of that money was shared equally among the 6 members of her co-op, and Raj, another member, received exactly the same share as Dana. Dana then paid 245 dollars for next week's lemons and sugar. How many dollars does Dana have left from her share?

The community garden rain barrel held 200 litres on Monday, and the volunteers measure it in litres even though the pump dial reads in millilitres, a thousand of which make a litre. They drew off 46 litres for the tomato beds, and a light drizzle added 7 litres. A storm that night tripled the amount in the barrel. On Wednesday they used 322 litres to soak the new orchard. Marisol worked out that the amount now left is exactly what the garden needs each week, and she wants to plan for 9 weeks. How many litres of water does the garden need for those 9 weeks?

Zara is in charge of the flyer stack for the summer festival, and the printer delivered 8 bundles with 171 flyers in each to make up the whole stack. Leo handed out 1135 flyers from the stack on the first day. Zara then printed 6 fresh flyers for every flyer still in the stack and replaced the old ones with them, so the stack held only the new prints. The festival has 4 stages. On the second day Zara handed out 609 flyers herself, far fewer than Leo had managed. For the final weekend she printed enough to make the stack 3 times as large. How many flyers are in the stack now?

Nia had 93 minutes before dinner to finish her homework, while her brother Eli had only 45 minutes for his, so Nia had the longer stretch of time. Her math sheet took her 27 minutes. Her mother then pushed dinner back and gave Nia 10 extra minutes. Nia spent 52 minutes on an essay and 15 minutes on her reading log, then 4 minutes packing her bag. She keeps her timer in minutes, though she knows sixty minutes make an hour and could convert it. How many minutes does Nia have left before dinner?

Priya is collecting ribbon for a costume and measures it in centimetres, though the pattern lists lengths in metres and she knows a hundred centimetres make a metre. She began with 146 centimetres of blue ribbon and cut off 16 centimetres for a bookmark. At the fabric shop, after waiting half an hour in line, she bought a 51-centimetre piece. Her aunt gave her a 32-centimetre piece and a 34-centimetre piece from her sewing box. How many centimetres of ribbon does Priya have now?

The Harbour Street food bank received 3 pallets with 136 cans of soup on each, and a church donation added 52 more cans. The manager planned to hand out all of those cans in equal amounts over the 4 days the food bank is open this week. On top of the planned cans, a neighbour drops off 32 extra cans every open day, and those are handed out the same day. The food bank has 6 volunteers on its roster. How many cans of soup will the food bank hand out over those 4 days in total?

Ravi manages the water supply for a charity run. In the morning he set out 208 bottles at the aid station, and a delivery van added 48 more. At midday he opened a second table stocked with exactly as many bottles as the first, so the station now had 2 tables of equal size. In the afternoon a neighbouring station handed over 37 bottles. In the evening the organiser told Ravi to prepare 4 stations for the weekend, each stocked with the same number of bottles his station had at the end of the day. How many bottles must Ravi prepare for the weekend in total?

Ana, who is a dozen years old, had 188 postage stamps in her album. Her friend Ben had only 45 stamps, far fewer than Ana, and he gave her all of them when he lost interest in collecting. Ana then sold 185 stamps to a dealer. At a swap meet another dealer gave her 18 free stamps to welcome her. She later gave 65 stamps to her cousin. How many stamps does Ana have in her album now?

Sofia bought 4 prepaid calling cards, each loaded with 96 minutes, and put all of the minutes onto her account. She used 289 minutes calling her parents overseas and then 84 minutes talking to a friend. The phone company then ran a promotion that made her remaining balance 2 times as large. She then spent 12 minutes on a call to the bank. The company bills in hours rather than minutes, so Sofia knows she will have to convert at the end of the month. How many minutes are left on Sofia's account?

At a tile warehouse the loading bay was empty when the morning shift began. Each rack holds 140 tiles, 3 racks fit on a trolley, and during the morning 8 trolleys were wheeled into the bay every hour for 3 hours. In the afternoon a quality check returned 33 tiles to the bay, and a second check returned 41 more. In the evening a truck took 5782 tiles away for delivery. How many tiles are in the loading bay now?

Ola collected 78 seashells on each of 3 days at the beach. Her friend Nils collected only 57 shells over the whole trip, far fewer than Ola. Ola donated 232 of her shells to the school nature display. Nils then gave Ola all 57 of his shells because he had no room for them. On the drive home 4 of Ola's shells broke and were thrown away. How many shells does Ola have now?
